jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
If you've ever wanted your engineering legacy to outlast your career, keep reading.

Mathews Brothers, Director of Engineering

📍 Location:
Belfast, Maine
💰 Salary Range:
$150,000 - $175,000 Annually (based on experience)
🏡 Relocation Assistance:
Available for the right candidate, preference given to New England Candidates
🌲 Lifestyle:
Live and work on the beautiful coast of Maine while leading innovation for one of America's most historic manufacturers.

Since 1854, Mathews Brothers has been manufacturing products that stand the test of time. Today, as America's oldest window manufacturer
, we're looking for a visionary engineering leader to help shape what the next chapter of that legacy looks like. This is a great opportunity for

As our next Director of Engineering
, you'll lead product development, research & development, quality assurance, testing, Lean initiatives, workflow improvements, and a talented engineering team. You'll partner with leadership across operations, production, purchasing, supply chain, and sales to drive meaningful innovation throughout the organization.

We're looking for someone who sees opportunities where others see obstacles. Someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, developing people, improving processes, and creating products that customers trust for decades.

At Mathews Brothers, You'll Have the Opportunity To

✅ Lead engineering for a company with more than 170 years of manufacturing history
✅ Influence the future of products used throughout the Northeast and beyond
✅ Drive Lean culture and continuous improvement initiatives
✅ Champion new product development and innovation
✅ Work for an organization that values craftsmanship, quality, and forward-thinking leadership

What You'll Be Responsible For

✅ Leading engineering initiatives across the organization
✅ Overseeing NFRC certifications and compliance with NAFS, AAMA/FGIA, and related industry standards
✅ Managing air, water, and structural testing programs through both simulation and physical testing methods
✅ Maintaining and improving product drawings, engineering databases, documentation, ECNs, SOPs, and quality control processes
✅ Providing technical troubleshooting, quality assurance oversight, and support to internal customers
✅ Driving research and development initiatives, including new product development, engineering reports, hardware testing, and service solutions
✅ Tracking R&D projects, costs, testing data, reports, and records to support operational and financial goals
✅ Leading Lean manufacturing initiatives, workflow optimization, process mapping, time studies, Kaizen events, and continuous improvement efforts
✅ Partnering with teams across all locations to improve safety, ergonomics, quality, throughput, and efficiency
✅ Developing, mentoring, and leading a team of 3-4 engineers while establishing clear goals and accountability

What Success Looks Like

✅ Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related technical field
✅ 4+ years of leadership experience with a proven track record of developing high-performing teams
✅ 4+ years of manufacturing experience in a fast-paced environment
✅ Experience with AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor, or similar engineering design software
✅ Knowledge of NFRC, FGIA/AAMA, ASTM, IECC, and IRC standards and requirements
✅ Demonstrated success managing projects from concept through implementation
✅ Experience with thermal modeling, 3D printing technology, and CNC/G-code operations is highly desirable
✅ Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
✅ Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments
✅ The ability to inspire teams, drive continuous improvement, and deliver measurable results against key performance indicators

For 170+ years, Mathews Brothers has built windows; we’re looking for someone to help build the next 170.

If that sounds like the challenge you've been waiting for, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

A Chief Engineer at Anduril provides senior technical leadership and oversight on products across major defense projects. They establish technical direction and engineering standards for significant system developments. They make critical technical decisions that impact product design, accompanying project execution, program success and company strategy. They are also a critical partner in customer engagement and management, and can act as a co-lead with the Program Manager. Chief Engineers are seen as the responsible party for their products, and are held accountable for technical delivery & safety.

What You’ll Do

Lead inter-disciplinary team (e.g., Software, Hardware, Robotics, T&E) to develop and deliver integrated systems for multi-purpose missions.
Set technical vision and define system architecture to guide overarching development efforts
Establish and maintain best practices for system development, including software standards, code reviews, configuration management, build processes, testing, etc.
Triage issues, conduct root cause analysis of failures, and coordinate next steps with engineering teams
Mentor junior engineers and ensure technical team is professionally developing at tenure-appropriate levels
Support local engagements with the local customer as the technical SME
Travel up to 25% of time to build, test, and deploy capabilities at Anduril test ranges and customer-directed sites

Core Requirements

Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret Clearance
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering. This is a hard requirement.
A minimum of 10 years of experience in autonomous systems, robotics, and defense applications within the intelligence or defense communities
Experience in a technical management/engineering role, leading teams to integrate software and hardware solutions.
Experience developing and executing complex technical programs to include
Optical sensing, radar, RF, EW
UAS Systems
Counter UAS Systems
Sensor integration
Networking / Communications / Command and Control

Systems Architecture - Sensor integration level (Delivered the systems specifically)
Rapid integration timeline and field testing/field deployment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with SITL and HITL simulation environments and the execution of comprehensive testing programs
Experience deploying technical solutions in the field both foreign and domestic

US Salary Range

$191,000—$253,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Director Software Dev Engineer
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Job Summary

As Director of Software Development Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building and scaling DeepHealth’s platform and products. You will drive technical strategy, architecture decisions, and engineering excellence across multiple teams, ensuring delivery of high-quality, reliable software that supports our mission in health technology.

Operating as a strategic partner to product, clinical, and business leadership, you will shape the engineering roadmap, cultivate a strong engineering culture, and build scalable systems and teams. You will also recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent, ensuring strong execution and measurable impact on business outcomes.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Engineering Strategy & Technical Leadership

Define and drive the multi-year engineering vision, technical roadmap, and platform strategy aligned with business goals
Lead architecture and design decisions for complex, distributed systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
Establish engineering standards, processes, and best practices to drive consistency, quality, and operational excellence
Own accountability for engineering delivery, system uptime, and technical debt management across the organization

Product Delivery & Engineering Execution

Partner with Product Management to define and execute the product roadmap, translating business requirements into engineering plans
Drive agile delivery practices across teams, ensuring on-time, high-quality releases that meet regulatory and compliance standards
Collaborate closely with Clinical, Data Science, and Design teams to shape technically sound and patient-centered solutions
Ensure consistency of engineering quality, code review culture, and testing standards across all teams and geographies

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment

Partner with Product, Clinical, and Data Science leaders to align engineering priorities with company strategy and customer needs
Communicate technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership and the Board
Establish engineering KPIs and OKRs, creating transparency and accountability across the organization
Drive innovation in tooling, automation, and AI/ML adoption to accelerate engineering velocity and product quality

Team Leadership & Organizational Impact

Recruit, retain, and develop world-class engineering talent across multiple disciplines, including backend, frontend, platform, and data engineering. Ensuring alignment with organizational policies and culture.
Define engineering team structure, roles, career ladders, and performance frameworks to support growth and retention
Build scalable engineering onboarding programs and a culture of continuous learning, psychological safety, and inclusive collaboration
Supervise, coach, and evaluate team members to ensure high performance and professional development.
Assign and prioritize workloads, monitor progress, and adjust resources to meet deadlines and objectives.
Set clear goals, conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback and development plans, and implement improvement plans when needed.
Foster a positive work environment by resolving conflicts proactively, promoting collaboration and accountability across the team, and maintaining clear communication across the team

Innovation & Engineering Culture

Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing engineering organization, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
Champion emerging technologies and evaluate build vs. buy decisions to accelerate innovation responsibly
Act as a key member of the executive leadership team, contributing to overall company strategy, culture, and decision-making
Influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across product, operations, commercial, and clinical functions

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Minimum Qualifications, Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required.
12+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in engineering leadership roles, ideally in SaaS, health tech, or regulated industries
Proven track record of building and scaling distributed software systems and high-performing engineering organizations
Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), microservices, APIs, and modern DevOps/CI-CD practices
A strategic thinker who’s equally comfortable diving into code, architecture reviews, and executive-level roadmap conversations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical topics to non-technical audiences
Strong analytical mindset with experience using engineering metrics, system performance data, and business outcomes to guide decisions
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with competing priorities
Excellent program management skills—able to drive multiple engineering initiatives in parallel with clarity and accountability
Experience with tools like GitHub, Jira, PagerDuty, Datadog, or similar engineering productivity and observability platforms
Experience working in HIPAA-compliant environments; familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) is a plus

Quality Standards

Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
Practices universal safety precautions.
Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

Working Environment

Remote

Physical Demands

This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

14

The Team

This team is essential to the division's data strategy, playing a key role in data transformation and leading efforts to replace legacy technical debt. The team embodies a strong commitment to delivering on business needs and demonstrates exceptional collaboration with both product and business partners. They are known for their collaborative approach, strong technical expertise, and the high energy and dedication they bring to their work.

Responsibilities And Impact

Lead and scale a world-class engineering organization of 100+ data engineers, ML engineers, and platform developers, including managing managers and Staff/Principal-level engineers while driving hiring, retention, and talent development strategies
Provide strategic technical direction for enterprise-scale lakehouse architecture using Databricks Data Intelligence Platform (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Mosaic AI) and AWS cloud services, ensuring highly performant, cost-effective, and interoperable data foundations
Drive the organization's transition to production-grade autonomous AI systems, leveraging Databricks AI stack including MLflow, Feature Store, Vector Search, and Model Serving to deliver measurable business value beyond proof-of-concept implementations
Establish rigorous engineering standards and operational excellence practices including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles for reliable platform delivery
Oversee enterprise semantic modeling and RAG architecture strategies, ensuring AI systems are grounded in Unity Catalog-governed data assets with proper access controls, lineage tracking, and auditability to prevent hallucinations
Foster a high-performance engineering culture rooted in psychological safety, continuous learning, and rapid experimentation while partnering with Product, FinOps, and executive leadership to translate business goals into actionable technical roadmaps

Compensation/Benefits Information

(This section is only applicable to US candidates) S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $185,000 to $265,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is not eligible for additional compensation such as an annual incentive bonus or sales commission plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.

What We're Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications:

15+ years of engineering experience with 5+ years directly managing and scaling large engineering teams at Director or Head of Engineering level, including experience managing managers and guiding Staff/Principal-level individual contributors through organizational transformation
Deep expertise in Databricks Data Intelligence Platform including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake internals, Delta Live Tables, Databricks Workflows, MLflow, and Mosaic AI, with ability to engage in technical discussions and provide strategic guidance on complex platform trade-offs
Extensive experience architecting enterprise-scale data platforms on AWS including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, AWS Lake Formation, with strong understanding of multi-region deployment strategies and security patterns (IAM, VPC, KMS)
Proven technical depth in Apache Iceberg internals, schema evolution, and cross-platform table strategies, combined with hands-on experience in autonomous AI agent deployment and RAG pipeline architecture for production environments
Demonstrated ability to build and scale engineering organizations from 20+ to 100+ engineers while establishing rigorous engineering standards, agile delivery practices, and operational SLAs for complex data and AI products
Strong leadership and communication skills with experience translating complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and influencing executive decision-making through data-driven recommendations and ROI analysis

Additional Preferred Qualifications

AWS and/or Databricks certifications with experience partnering with FinOps and cloud platform teams to optimize cloud consumption, performance, and platform ROI across multi-cloud data platform strategies
Experience with semantic modeling, knowledge graphs, and enterprise data governance frameworks including metadata management and secure data sharing patterns at enterprise scale
Background in LLMOps, model evaluation, and prompt orchestration with familiarity integrating AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon SageMaker and Amazon Bedrock into broader enterprise AI platform strategies
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation including Databricks Asset Bundles for repeatable, auditable platform delivery across distributed cloud environments

jobs.title: Regional Director, Architecture & Engineering
jobs.description:
Regional Director, Architecture & Engineering

Phoenix, AZ

Our client is a growing, multidisciplinary architecture and engineering organization entering an exciting stage of expansion in the Southwest. They are seeking an accomplished regional leader to guide a high-performing Arizona operation, strengthen its architecture and engineering capabilities, and help shape the next chapter of the business. This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for someone who wants more than responsibility for a single discipline. The Regional Director will have meaningful influence across people, operations, client strategy, financial performance, project delivery, and long-term growth.

The ideal leader combines the commercial instincts of a business executive with the credibility to lead experienced architecture and engineering professionals. This person will inherit an established platform while having the opportunity to develop leaders, expand key relationships, improve business performance, and build an organization positioned for sustainable growth.

This Role Offers

Executive-level influence over the strategy and performance of a growing regional architecture and engineering operation.
Opportunity to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams while building the next generation of organizational leadership.
A highly collaborative environment that values entrepreneurial thinking, technical excellence, accountability, and strong client relationships.
Significant visibility with senior leadership and the ability to influence growth initiatives, organizational planning, and future expansion.
A role that combines strategic leadership with tangible ownership of financial, operational, talent, and client outcomes.
Competitive executive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including performance-based variable compensation and bonus opportunity, with potential stock or equity participation.
The resources of a broader organization combined with an environment that values local leadership, relationships, and market expertise.

Focus

Set the strategic direction for regional architecture and engineering operations, translating broader business priorities into measurable goals for growth, execution, and team performance.
Own regional business results across revenue, profitability, forecasting, utilization, staffing, resource planning, and overall operational health.
Recruit, coach, develop, and retain high-performing professionals while strengthening leadership capabilities and succession planning across the organization.
Unite architecture, engineering, project management, and supporting functions around an integrated approach to project delivery, quality, resource allocation, and client service.
Maintain executive oversight of significant projects, helping teams navigate delivery risks, contractual requirements, financial challenges, and complex client matters.
Strengthen relationships with key clients and prospects while partnering with practice leaders on business development, pursuit strategy, presentations, negotiations, and market expansion.
Identify and implement opportunities to improve workflows, communication, technology adoption, operational consistency, and scalable business practices.
Partner with senior leadership on strategic planning, organizational development, growth initiatives, and the integration of future expansion opportunities.
Represent the organization within the regional A&E community while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, professional development, and technical excellence.

Skill Set

Bachelor’s degree in architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering Management, or a related discipline.
15 or more years of progressive experience within architecture, engineering, multidisciplinary consulting, or a closely related professional services environment.
Significant leadership experience overseeing multidisciplinary teams, business operations, project delivery, client relationships, and organizational performance.
Demonstrated financial and business acumen, including responsibility for revenue, profitability, forecasting, utilization, staffing, and resource planning.
Proven ability to develop leaders, build high-performing teams, strengthen organizational capability, and successfully navigate periods of growth or change.
Strong commercial orientation with experience cultivating strategic client relationships, developing new business, and identifying opportunities for market or service expansion.
Working knowledge of architecture and engineering project delivery, including project economics, quality expectations, risk management, and resource requirements.
Strong executive presence, communication, decision-making, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, operational, client, and executive audiences.

6+ years of software development experience with a strong understanding of modern engineering practices and software lifecycle management.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Klaviyo’s mission is to empower businesses to independently drive their growth, and the Engineering Department's contribution to this mission is crucial. As Director of Production Infrastructure, you'll helm the creation and management of a high-performance platform designed to support the rapid innovation demanded by our R&D teams. This role is all about defining the pillars of our infrastructure, compute, storage, networking, observability, and setting a robust set of principles that guide their use.

In this position, you'll be entrusted with the responsibility of developing and maintaining platform primitives that empower our engineering teams to bring ideas to life seamlessly. Collaborating with industry leaders across engineering, security, and finance, your decisions will shape the infrastructure blueprint that underpins our scalable, secure, and cost-effective operations. As a leader, your mission is to foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and productivity while steering teams toward achieving critical reliability and performance metrics. Your role will span across defining clear service contracts, instituting capacity plans, and honing our developer enablement strategy to reduce friction and enhance developer velocity.

How You’ll Make a Difference

Lead the definition of platform primitives such as compute runtimes, storage options, and service networking, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned with Klaviyo's standards for operational excellence.
Create and disseminate golden paths and decision trees that simplify the technological choices for R&D teams, enhancing consistency and self-sufficiency across engineering efforts.
Drive initiatives that enhance the reliability of production systems, focusing on incident prevention, transparent response protocols, and proactive capacity planning.
Coordinate with product teams to identify and eliminate infrastructure bottlenecks, aiding in improving the time-to-market for new services and increasing developer satisfaction.
Establish frameworks for cost-effective infrastructure management, balancing financial discipline with flexibility and efficiency to maximize value delivery.
Mentor and develop high-performing teams, fostering a culture of inclusivity and ownership, while setting clear, impactful goals that align with business priorities.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners to manage platform investments, clarify ownership, and safely implement infrastructure changes that drive strategic outcomes.
Track and report critical performance metrics, such as system reliability, developer productivity, and infrastructure costs, enabling data-driven decision-making and accountability.
Optimize the use of AI to enhance infrastructure management and development processes, pioneering innovative workflows that keep Klaviyo at the forefront of technological advancement.
Champion operational readiness by establishing robust SLAs and SLIs, ensuring all infrastructure components meet defined performance thresholds conforming to Klaviyo's quality standards.
Facilitate a culture of continuous learning and experimentation with AI tools, deploying enhancements that intelligently streamline engineering workflows.
Lead a disciplined approach to incident management and postmortems, establishing a blameless culture of learning and innovation to minimize future disruptions.

Who You Are

You have over 10 years of experience in infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, or security engineering, with at least 5 years managing managers and senior ICs, demonstrating strong leadership and team-building skills.
Your leadership style fosters inclusivity and empowerment, setting high standards that inspire your teams to achieve ambitious goals aligned with Klaviyo's mission.
You possess a deep understanding of SRE principles, with proven expertise in designing effective SLOs and SLIs, managing incidents, and ensuring capacity planning and operational continuity.
You have experience with LiveSite (the enterprise web platform) and understand the infrastructure requirements, integration patterns, and operational demands that come with supporting enterprise-grade web properties at scale.
You own the live site, you bring urgency, clear judgment, and a structured approach to production incidents, and you build teams that treat uptime and reliability as first-order concerns, not afterthoughts. You have a proven track record of standing up or strengthening LiveSite culture inside engineering orgs.
You excel at simplifying complexity and creating logical clarity, using your strong communication skills to drive organizational changes across product, data, and security domains.
Your decision-making is driven by outcomes, and you're comfortable prioritizing initiatives that deliver the most significant business impact, even if it means narrowing the scope.
Your hands-on experience with AI makes you AI-curious, and you're eager to leverage it to drive smarter, more efficient infrastructure operations.
Your technical expertise is both broad and deep, you command public cloud services, container orchestration, service meshing, data storage, and observability at a systems level, and you remain hands-on when it counts, able to roll up your sleeves and debug a complex distributed-systems problem alongside your team.
You build and nurture a culture of ownership and continuous improvement, encouraging your teams to innovate and excel while maintaining a strong focus on customer value.
You possess a keen ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, ensuring infrastructure solutions not only meet current needs but are future-proof and scalable.
You are an org builder, you know how to scale a team thoughtfully, develop high-potential engineers into managers, and create the conditions for leaders to emerge and grow.
You raise the bar relentlessly, you set high standards for engineering excellence, hold yourself and your teams accountable to those standards, and invest continuously in growing the people around you.
You are an org builder, you know how to scale a team thoughtfully, develop high-potential engineers into managers, and create the conditions for leaders to emerge and grow.
You raise the bar relentlessly, you set high standards for engineering excellence, hold yourself and your teams accountable to those standards, and invest continuously in growing the people around you.
Committed to fostering a learning environment, you continually seek ways to improve team skills, processes, and technologies to align with Klaviyo's growth and innovation objectives.

Previous experience in transforming internal platforms into productized services, complete with SLAs and developer experience-focused roadmaps.
Background in architecting data-centric and event-driven systems at a large scale, particularly within a high-growth environment.

Why This Role Matters

The Director of Production Infrastructure at Klaviyo is a mission-critical role that directly influences the core foundations of our technology stack. Ensuring that our infrastructure is robust, scalable, and future-proof enables our engineering teams to accelerate product development effectively and safely, cementing Klaviyo’s position as an industry leader in empowering business growth.

Your leadership will impact our ability to innovate rapidly and maintain the high standards of reliability our customers expect. jobs.description:
To thrive as a company and meet our impact goals, we must cultivate a culture of high-performance. You can read about our culture principles here.

We know managers are often the single-largest driver of employee satisfaction and growth, and our talent is our biggest asset. Because of that, we’ve identified consistent expectations for all of Guild’s people managers — helping you know what to expect from your experience here.

If you are an Internal Candidate, please apply via our Internal Job Board.

Guild is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead our product, platform, and foundational engineering teams. In this role, you’ll own how these teams plan, build, and ship — balancing reliable, efficient delivery with the growth bets that move the business. We’re looking for a seasoned engineering leader who’s energized by leading at this level, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and focused on driving to clear outcomes.

As VP Of Engineering, You Will

Set technical and organizational direction across product, platform, and foundational engineering — turning Guild’s business strategy into a clear roadmap and putting your teams’ effort where it matters most.
Own how the organization plans and ships — estimation, release readiness, and incident response — improving predictability and throughput with lightweight process, and clearing the blockers that slow teams down.
Balance shipping solid, reliable software with placing growth bets — deciding when to harden core systems and pay down tech debt, and when to fund the experiments that open new growth for members and employer partners.
Own the internal platform and foundational engineering — DevOps, shared services, CI/CD, and testing — so product teams can ship without wrestling the plumbing and the systems underneath stay reliable and secure.
Lead through ambiguity to outcomes — bring clarity to messy problems, decide with incomplete information, and keep teams focused on measurable impact as priorities shift.
Develop leaders and talent — coach and grow multiple Directors and Engineering Managers, set clear expectations, give frequent and actionable feedback, and create stretch opportunities so your people do the best work of their careers.
Build an inclusive, sustainable engineering culture — psychologically safe teams, a modern and AI-forward way of working, and a pace people can keep.
Partner across the company — work closely with Product, Design, and Data & AI engineering leaders, and represent engineering with executives and key vendors (e.g., AWS, Auth0) to align technical investment with company priorities.

You are a strong fit for this role if you have:

Proven ability to lead a multi-team engineering organization at the VP level — setting direction across several domains and owning outcomes across both product and platform engineering. You’re energized by leading well at this level and the scope it carries.
Demonstrated people-leadership as a manager of managers — you set clear standards, drive execution and remove blockers, grow talent through frequent, actionable feedback, and build psychologically safe, inclusive teams.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving to outcomes — you simplify complexity, make practical trade-offs with incomplete information, and orient teams around measurable impact rather than activity.
Deep technical credibility — you can weigh architectural decisions on their merits and earn the trust of senior engineers — plus the judgment to balance reliable, cost-aware systems with room for growth bets.
Strong cross-functional partnership — you build trust with Product, Design, and peer engineering leaders, and explain technical strategy and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives.

Experience scaling consumer or B2B2C growth-product engineering and/or internal developer platforms in a high-growth environment.
Familiarity with a modern AWS serverless stack (e.g., Lambda, Aurora), GraphQL, and the tooling that supports an AI-native software development lifecycle.
Experience leading engineering through an AI-native transformation — building with AI as a first class citizen, agentic workflows, and platform guardrails responsibly.
Background partnering with Data/AI engineering to ship AI-native product experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Center Infrastructure Management, Intelligence & Controls
jobs.description:
Flexential operates more than 40 data centers across roughly 18 markets and over 330 MW built or under development, with high-density, AI-ready capacity now central to our growth.

The Senior Director, Data Center Intelligence & Controls owns the systems, data, and controls that tell us how every facility is performing: capacity, power topology, telemetry, controls, and the operational metrics the business bills and reports on.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can step into a complex, fast-moving environment, take ownership of the DCIM, capacity engineering, controls, and telemetry functions, and make them trustworthy, well-run, and resilient. You will stabilize the teams, harden the data behind billing and capacity decisions, make the function well-documented and resilient, and build the operational foundation for a software-defined, digital-twin future.

It is high-impact work with a clear line of sight to defining how Flexential runs its fleet.

Key Responsibilities And Essential Job Functions

DCIM and Data Ownership

Own the system of record. Take ownership of the DCIM platform as the authoritative source for capacity, assets, power topology, and facility state, and keep it accurate and trusted across operations, engineering, sales, and finance.
Harden data quality. Establish telemetry standards, point naming, and data-quality governance, and grade data health so issues are found and fixed before they cause revenue loss or bad decisions.
Drive consolidation. Begin unifying the configuration management database and integrating disconnected systems toward a single source of operational truth.

Capacity Engineering and Commercial Support

Run capacity and forecasting. Own capacity planning, forecasting, and optimization across power, space, and cooling, including utility load-ramp forecasts.
Manage reserves and utilization. Reconcile committed, drawn, and utilized power and adjust reserves to protect both sellable inventory and uptime.
Support the deal with data. Run technical design reviews, cage plots, and density-feasibility analysis, giving the business a clear, data-backed view of capacity.

Controls, Telemetry, and Metering

Stabilize controls. Take ownership of building automation and controls, set standards for sequences of operation and alarm management, and tune the mechanical and electrical environment for reliability and efficiency.
Own the instrumentation layer. Run branch-circuit monitoring, environmental monitoring, and power-data acquisition, and ensure every usage-based site is fully instrumented before customer turn-up.
Close metering gaps. Drive the program to close remaining metering and monitoring gaps, treating data integrity as a revenue-protection function.

Billing Data, Metrics, and Risk

Protect billing integrity. Own the data behind PUE-based billing, usage, PUE, and rate, with anomaly detection, variance flagging, and reconstruction methods that prevent revenue leakage.
Own the operational metrics. Utilization, salable and built capacity, forecast accuracy, automation coverage, PUE and WUE, and the metrics that feed financial and capital reporting.
Identify risk in the data. Use operational data and modeling, including redundancy and failover modeling (N+1, 2N), to identify risk early and route clear, prioritized actions to teams so issues are remediated proactively.

Leadership

Stabilize and build the team. Take ownership of the capacity engineering, operations engineering, controls, and telemetry groups, clarify roles, close gaps, and build a unit that operates with discipline and pride.
Build a resilient function. Document and cross-train so the function’s knowledge is well-distributed across the team, and partner across Facilities, Engineering, Construction, Sales, Product, IT, and Finance.

Required Qualifications

Hands-on leadership of controls, BAS, DCIM, capacity engineering, or telemetry teams in mission-critical environments.
Deep, practical command of BAS and controls, telemetry, and DCIM; you can read a trend log, a one-line, and a capacity model and know what they are telling you.
Strong grasp of MEP systems, switchgear, UPS, generators, chillers, CRAH and CRAC units, and PDUs, and how they behave under load and during failover.
Working knowledge of colocation capacity mechanics: reserves, utilization, and PUE-based billing.
Experience with DCIM and branch-circuit and environmental monitoring, and integrating systems over BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP.
A record of inheriting complex environments and leaving them measurably better, with cleaner data, calmer floors, and stronger teams, plus credibility with frontline technicians and shift leads.

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months

First 90 Days

Assessed every inherited function, system, and data source.
Delivered a candid current-state and stabilization plan.
Made the function more resilient through documentation and cross-training.

By Month 6

Telemetry, metering, and data-quality governance are live and trusted.
PUE-based billing data and capacity reserves are accurate and defensible.
Data-driven risk identification runs on a dependable cadence so teams can act early.

By Month 12

DCIM and CMDB consolidation are underway.
Controls are measurably more reliable and efficient.
Metering gaps are closed across usage-based sites.
Put forward the roadmap toward the software-defined, digital-twin target state.

. However, the actual pay range depends on each candidate’s experience, location, and qualifications.

Variable Pay:
Discretionary annual bonus, based on personal and company performance.

Brief Description

About All Points Broadband

All Points Broadband is a fast-growing fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) provider dedicated to bridging the digital divide and bringing high-speed internet access to underserved communities throughout Virginia and beyond. Headquartered in Richmond, VA, we are committed to building and operating state-of-the-art fiber networks that empower residents, businesses, and communities with the connectivity they need to thrive in today's digital world.

As a dynamic and rapidly growing FTTH provider, All Points Broadband fosters a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture where teamwork and innovation are highly valued. We operate as one cohesive team, working together to drive rapid growth and achieve ambitious goals. We empower our employees to take ownership, contribute their unique talents, and make a real difference in connecting communities. If you're looking for a fast-paced environment where you can learn, grow, and contribute, All Points Broadband is the place for you.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a network engineering leader who will be responsible for oversight, leadership and management of the design and engineering of our fiber based GPOM service delivery and access networks. Your primary duties will include oversight for the engineering, design, implementation planning, construction, test and turnup and certification of fiber-based gigabit optical network equipment and networks. Including hardware, network element software, and some other related systems. Supporting recovery operations as necessary. Providing guidance as required trouble shooting, repairing and replacing faulty network hardware components when necessary. You will also be working closely with the users of our network in order to identify potential issues and fix existing problems.

To be a successful candidate, you will need to have a strong understanding of transport, network infrastructure, network hardware and design. You will also need to be able to support implementation, administration and troubleshooting of network devices including firewalls, routers, switches, and controllers. A deep knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols is highly desired.

Key Responsibilities

Assisting and overseeing the design and development of a multistate regional consumer ISP with the mission of delivering broadband internet to the most rural regional communities.
Working alongside leadership peers to drive an aggressive design, development and construction plan. Working to find consensus on solutions that drive the overall project to plan.
Collaborating and negotiating with key vendor partners on technology solutions.
Maintaining and administering service delivery networks and related environments that may include systems software, applications software, hardware, and configurations.
Performing disaster recovery operations and data backups when required.
Protecting data, software, and hardware by coordinating, planning, and implementing network security measures.
Troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving hardware, software, and other network and system problems.
Replacing faulty network hardware components when required.
Along with Network Operations Center teams, monitor network performance to determine if adjustments need to be made.
Conferring with network users about solving existing system problems.
Operating master consoles to monitor the performance of networks and computer systems.
Coordinating network access and use.
Designing, configuring, and testing networking software, element management and other operating system software.

Required Skills And Experience

A minimum of 10 years' experience designing and configuring network infrastructure, network hardware and transport layers.
Ability to think through problems and visualize solutions. Emotional and intellectual agility, while working in a fast-paced environment.
Strong cross functional collaboration with technical operations leadership peers.
Ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including firewall, routers, switches, controllers.
Knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols.
Ability to create accurate network diagrams and documentation for design, planning and implementation of network communication systems.
Provides specific detailed information for hardware and software selection.
Ability to work with all levels of staff within and outside of IT and outside the organization.
Proficient knowledge in network security.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, electrical engineering, computer engineering or related field of study with a network engineering focus.

Summary

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, and retirement savings. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Web Platform Engineering based in United States.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role responsible for the technical direction of a large-scale, Sitecore-based web platform and its broader digital ecosystem.

You will partner closely with product leadership to translate business priorities such as lead generation, SEO, personalization, experimentation, and conversion into scalable technical solutions.

The role combines architecture, coding, engineering standards, people leadership, and production ownership.

You’ll help shape modern headless web experiences using technologies such as Sitecore AI, Next.js/React, Vercel, and enterprise search platforms.

You’ll also drive AI-forward engineering practices, automated testing, knowledge sharing, and integration with broader data and AI capabilities.

As a leader-doer, you’ll remain close to the technology while coaching engineers, strengthening team capabilities, and guiding architectural decisions.

This is an opportunity to influence a globally used digital platform while building a pragmatic, collaborative, and continuously improving engineering culture.

Own the technical direction and architecture of the web platform, partnering as a peer with product leadership to shape priorities, sequencing, and long-term platform strategy.
Translate business objectives—including lead generation, leasing, SEO, personalization, experimentation, and campaign enablement—into practical technical strategies and scalable solutions.
Remain hands-on in architecture, development, code reviews, technical design, and engineering standards while serving as the technical example for the team.
Lead the evolution of a Sitecore-based, headless web ecosystem, including personalization, experimentation, content delivery, and modern frontend architecture.
Guide strategy for site search and discovery, ensuring relevance, scalability, performance, and user experience remain aligned with business goals.
Partner with marketing and content teams to evolve content management and operational capabilities.

Evaluate and adopt AI-enabled capabilities for content operations, personalization, experimentation, and testing.
Lead, mentor, and develop engineers through technical coaching, performance management, career planning, and targeted hiring.
Build a culture of shared ownership by documenting architecture, integrations, operational procedures, and platform knowledge while cross-training team members.
Own L2/L3 production support, break-fix resolution, release processes, deployment standards, and on-call practices, ensuring platform issues are resolved within established SLAs.
Represent the web platform in enterprise technology planning and collaborate across global teams to align technical direction with broader organizational priorities.

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. jobs.title: Sr. Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
About Gap Inc.

At Gap Inc., we create culture as much as we create clothes. Our ambition is to become a high-performing house of iconic American brands that shape culture.

Our portfolio—Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta—each brings a distinct point of view to how we show up in the world and serve our customers.

Old Navy democratizes style with quality and value for all. Gap champions originality through essential pieces that celebrate individuality. Banana Republic is rooted in a spirit of discovery, creating modern pieces inspired by craftsmanship and travel. Athleta champions the Power of She through confidence, strength, and movement.

We’re driven by a shared purpose: to bridge gaps—between people, perspectives, and possibilities—to create a better world.

We’re building a team that performs at a high level—people who think boldly, take ownership, and turn ideas into impact. If you’re ready to learn fast and help shape what’s next, you’ll fit right in.

About The Role

The Senior Director, Platform Engineering leads the strategy, development, and operations of our enterprise Cloud Platform across Azure and GCP. This role owns the Continuous Delivery Platform built on Kubernetes, drives FinOps discipline to optimize cloud spend, and ensures teams can build, ship, and run software with speed and confidence. You will shape the modern DevOps tech stack and champion infrastructure automation through Terraform, enabling engineering teams across the organization to deliver at scale. Your leadership will directly impact developer productivity, system reliability, and the pace of innovation.

What you'll do

CLOUD PLATFORM STRATEGY & ENGINEERING

Define and execute the multi-cloud platform strategy across Azure and GCP, ensuring architectural consistency, security, and scalability.
Lead the design and evolution of shared platform services — networking, identity, compute, storage, and observability — as self-service capabilities for product engineering teams.
Own the API gateway and service mesh layer (Istio), enabling secure, observable, and resilient service-to-service communication across the platform.
Evaluate emerging cloud-native technologies and make build-vs-buy decisions that balance innovation with operational sustainability.
Partner with Security, Architecture, and Compliance teams to embed governance and policy-as-code into every layer of the platform.

Continuous Delivery & Developer Experience

Own and evolve the enterprise Continuous Delivery Platform built on Kubernetes, enabling teams to build, test, ship, and schedule workloads reliably.
Drive adoption of modern CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, GitOps workflows, and progressive delivery practices (canary, blue-green, feature flags).
Champion developer experience (DevEx) as a first-class product — reducing friction from code commit to production through self-service tooling, golden paths, and internal developer portals.
Establish and track platform adoption metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR) aligned with DORA benchmarks.

INFRASTRUCTURE AUTOMATION & DEVOPS EXCELLENCE

Lead the infrastructure-as-code practice using Terraform, ensuring all cloud resources are provisioned, versioned, and managed through automated, repeatable pipelines.
Drive the DevOps culture and toolchain strategy — standardizing on modern practices for configuration management, secrets management, service mesh, and policy enforcement.
Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules, landing zones, and account/project vending solutions that accelerate onboarding of new workloads and teams.
Ensure infrastructure changes flow through the same CI/CD rigor as application code, with automated testing, drift detection, and compliance checks.

OBSERVABILITY, MONITORING & EVENT STREAMING

Define and own the enterprise observability strategy — ensuring comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting across all platform services and application workloads.
Lead the implementation and standardization of monitoring toolchains (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations Suite) to provide real-time visibility into system health and performance.
Own the platform's event streaming and messaging infrastructure built on Apache Kafka, enabling reliable, high-throughput, real-time data pipelines across the organization.
Establish SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets as the foundation for reliability decisions, partnering with product engineering teams to drive a culture of proactive incident prevention.
Ensure distributed tracing and service dependency mapping are in place across the Istio service mesh, enabling rapid root cause analysis during incidents.

API GATEWAY & SERVICE MESH MANAGEMENT

Lead the strategy and operations of the Istio service mesh and API gateway layer, providing traffic management, mutual TLS, rate limiting, and fine-grained access control across microservices.
Define and enforce API lifecycle management standards — versioning, deprecation policies, schema governance, and developer documentation.
Partner with application teams to optimize service-to-service communication patterns, latency, and resilience through circuit breaking, retries, and intelligent routing.
Ensure API gateway and mesh configurations are managed as code, fully integrated into the CI/CD pipeline with automated canary analysis and rollback.

FINOPS & CLOUD FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT

Establish and lead the FinOps practice, creating visibility, accountability, and optimization of cloud spend across Azure and GCP.
Implement cost allocation frameworks (tagging, showback/chargeback) that tie cloud consumption to business units, products, and teams.
Partner with Finance, Procurement, and Engineering leadership to forecast cloud budgets, manage committed-use agreements, and identify savings opportunities.
Build dashboards and reporting cadences that keep cloud costs transparent from engineering teams to executive leadership.

TEAM LEADERSHIP & ORGANIZATIONAL DEVELOPMENT

Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing platform engineering organization spanning SRE, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, observability, and FinOps disciplines.
Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and blameless incident learning.
Attract and retain top engineering talent by creating an environment of technical excellence, psychological safety, and meaningful career growth.
Establish clear team charters, on-call rotations, SLOs, and operational readiness standards.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

Serve as the primary technology leader for cloud platform and delivery infrastructure, communicating strategy, roadmaps, and trade-offs to executive leadership.
Partner with product engineering, data engineering, security, and enterprise architecture teams to align platform capabilities with business priorities.
Coordinate transparent, timely communications on platform health, incidents, capacity, and upcoming changes.
Prepare and deliver executive summaries covering platform performance, cost trends, reliability metrics, and strategic initiatives.

Who you are

15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles managing managers.
Deep hands-on background in cloud platforms (Azure and/or GCP required; multi-cloud experience strongly preferred).
Proven experience building and operating Kubernetes-based platforms at enterprise scale, including container orchestration, Istio service mesh, and workload scheduling.
Strong expertise in API gateway architecture, service mesh (Istio), traffic management, and microservices communication patterns.
Demonstrated experience with enterprise observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent), including SLI/SLO frameworks and incident management.
Hands-on knowledge of event streaming and messaging platforms, particularly Apache Kafka, for building real-time data pipelines at scale.
Strong command of infrastructure-as-code practices with Terraform and modern DevOps toolchains (CI/CD, GitOps, observability, secrets management).
Demonstrated success standing up or maturing a FinOps function, including cost optimization, tagging strategies, and cloud financial governance.
Track record of building high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and continuous delivery.
Excellent executive communication skills — able to translate complex technical strategies into business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders.
Experience driving platform adoption and developer experience as an internal product, using metrics and feedback loops to guide investment.
Strong knowledge of DORA metrics, SRE principles, and modern reliability practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD) or Terraform certifications (HashiCorp Certified).
Cloud certifications in Azure (Solutions Architect Expert) and/or GCP (Professional Cloud Architect).
FinOps Certified Practitioner or equivalent experience with the FinOps Foundation framework.

Director, Client Software Development Services

The Impact You Will Have

VC3 is a leading Managed, Security and Professional Services Provider partnering with public and commercial organizations across North America to secure, operate, modernize their technology. Our Software Development Services team partners with clients to design, build, and evolve the software that runs their business, including: a custom purpose-built software solutions for the local government, compliance and education sectors.

The Director, Software Development Services is primarily a leadership role and owns practice P&L, team performance and client outcomes and is expected to raise the bar on both the people and the results. This leader is responsible for web development (front and back end), software development (including custom, automation, API, integration and Agentic AI development), and VC3’s EdTech commercial product. The role has a clear mandate to scale the practice commercially while transforming the team to an AI-first, code-generation-driven engineering model.

The ideal candidate is a former Software Engineer or DevOps lead who has built and grown a software practice inside a services organization. The role is hands-on with AI-first development tooling, comfortable in front of external clients, and motivated by the opportunity to grow the client base, revenue and mature best practices.

Own the technical roadmap and delivery for client web and software engagements across modern web (React, Next.js) and cross-platform stacks.

Closely collaborate with the Lead, AI and Data practice to: 1) Parlay software developed through client engagements into commercial go-to-market client offerings as part of the VC3 Managed AI Offering, 2) set AI Council agenda, 3) standardize AI best practices

Clear plan and early traction on practice growth, pipeline build, new logos, and/or expanded scope with existing clients.
Team confidently shipping AI-generated and AI-reviewed code as standard practice, supported by a documented engineering playbook.
Visible modernization progress on the EdTech product, with a credible roadmap toward an AI-native offering.
An upskilled, motivated team operating under modernized rituals and tooling.

A minimum of 5 years leading Software Development teams and 8+ years of software development experience
Proven ability to grow software delivery services with external clients across delivery, capability, and commercial performance.
AI and Software Development Services experience, demonstrated history of building and scaling an App Dev or Software practice inside a services organization.
Hands-on AI-first practitioner, personally shipped production work using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and agentic workflows.
Track record of transitioning traditional engineering teams to code-generation-driven practices.
Full stack development experience (including DB, API and data integration)
Sales experience or strong pre-sales acumen, scoping, SOWs, client pitches, and account growth.
Experience evolving an existing product into a more AI-native offering.
P&L, utilization, and capacity planning experience in an AI and Software Development Services environment.

This role may require occasional travel to client sites, VC3 offices, and industry events. Some VC3 engagements involve work with public-sector clients; the successful candidate must be willing to complete background checks consistent with those engagements.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

As a Product Manager on our Enterprise Platform team, you’ll shape the foundation that makes Fivetran scalable, secure, and extensible for thousands of enterprise customers.

You’ll lead key initiatives across the platform–enterprise-grade security and governance, user and workspace configuration, and observability tooling—ensuring customers can confidently configure, govern, and scale Fivetran usage.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role, perfect for product leaders who thrive on technical challenges, tight feedback loops, and opportunities to shape long-term platform strategy. You’ll balance usability and self-service with enterprise-grade requirements like scale, security, and governance.

This is a full-time position based out of our Denver, CO office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for key platform features
Partner closely with engineering and design to define and deliver robust, intuitive functionality that meets the needs of enterprise customers.
Understand customer needs by engaging directly with users, analyzing feedback and usage data, and collaborating with support, sales, and solutions engineering.
Drive cross-functional alignment and go-to-market readiness for major product launches.
Stay on the pulse of trends in developer platforms, data infrastructure, and enterprise tooling—with an eye toward AI-first opportunities.

Product management experience in B2B SaaS or cloud platforms.
A strong technical foundation—comfortable working on APIs, backend systems, developer tools, or security platforms.
A track record of owning complex initiatives and delivering high-impact outcomes for technical users.
Exceptional collaboration and communication skills across product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.
Analytical mindset and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Bonus Skills

Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tooling (e.g., ELT/ETL, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, Snowflake, Databricks).
Experience with enterprise security and compliance standards (e.g., SSO, RBAC, audit logging, SOC2).
Prior work on developer tools, SDKs, or extensibility platforms.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced environment.

About The Role

The Director, AI Platform & Portfolio Delivery is accountable for translating BetMGM’s AI strategy into a prioritized, governed, and executable portfolio of AI initiatives. This role owns the AI portfolio intake and delivery model, partnering closely with PMO to balance business value, delivery capacity, risk, and timing.

The Director leads AI delivery through a Technical AI Director/Builder responsible for AWS-based platforms, agentic frameworks, and early use cases—ensuring solutions move efficiently from intake to production while meeting enterprise standards for security, compliance, and scalability.

This role blends portfolio leadership, delivery accountability, and platform stewardship.

Responsibilities

Own the AI portfolio intake process, including intake criteria, evaluation frameworks, and prioritization mechanisms, in close partnership with PMO to align AI demand with enterprise planning cycles, capacity management, and dependencies.
Evaluate AI opportunities based on business value, measurable outcomes, technical feasibility, delivery effort, risk, compliance considerations, time‑to‑impact, and scalability potential.
Maintain a transparent, prioritized AI roadmap and communicate sequencing decisions, tradeoffs, and delivery status to executive and cross‑functional stakeholders.
Translate enterprise AI strategy and approved portfolio priorities into an executable delivery roadmap with clear milestones, ownership, and success metrics.
Define, track, and report on realized value from AI initiatives, including cost reduction, revenue enablement, customer experience improvements, and operational efficiency gains.
Establish and own the AI delivery operating model, including standardized AI and agent SDLC practices, production readiness criteria, release management, monitoring, and incident response.
Define reusable architecture patterns, tooling standards, and platform guardrails that enable consistent, secure, and scalable AI solution delivery.
Provide leadership, direction, and oversight to the Technical AI Director/Builder responsible for AWS‑based AI platforms, agentic frameworks, core infrastructure, and early production use cases.
Balance rapid experimentation and proof‑of‑value delivery with long‑term platform sustainability, reliability, and enterprise readiness.
Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Technology Risk teams to operationalize AI governance and ensure solutions meet regulatory, privacy, and security requirements.
Ensure AI risk management is embedded into delivery processes through built‑in controls, monitoring, and clearly defined escalation paths.
Serve as the primary AI delivery partner to Product, Operations, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Technology teams, translating technical progress into business‑relevant insights.
Manage cross‑functional dependencies and resolve delivery risks, blockers, and prioritization conflicts using sound judgment and enterprise‑level perspective.
Lead, coach, and develop AI leaders and senior contributors, establishing clear goals, expectations, and development paths.
Build workforce and hiring plans aligned to the growth and maturity of the AI portfolio and platform capabilities.

Qualifications

Required

10+ years in software/data/ML engineering leadership, including responsibility for delivering production platforms or mission-critical services.
Proven experience scaling delivery from proof-of-concept to production (operating model, quality, reliability, stakeholder management).
Strong cloud and modern engineering background (e.g., AWS ecosystem; CI/CD; observability; security fundamentals).
Demonstrated ability to manage leaders (e.g., managing a “builder” director/manager-level role) and drive outcomes through others.

Preferred

Experience delivering AI/ML platforms or agent-based/automation solutions in production.
Familiarity with model risk management, governance patterns, and enterprise data/privacy constraints.
Experience in highly regulated or consumer-facing digital products where reliability, security, and trust are essential.
Strong vendor/partner management experience (platform tools, consultancies, managed services).

The annual salary range for this position is $176,240 to $230,000. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is a global platform company that is on a mission to power prosperity around the world for consumers and businesses. Across our leading brands – Turbo Tax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp
– Intuit serves over 100M customers and is one of the few companies in the world to have both a thriving consumer and business ecosystem. Intuit is known for its innovation track record, customer centricity, and its consistent recognition as a top place to work.

Intuit Customer Success (ICS) is evolving from a traditional support function into a core growth and experience engine for Intuit. As part of our AI-powered, services-led platform strategy, ICS orchestrates advanced AI capabilities and human expertise to deliver “done-for-you” experiences that drive revenue growth, deepen customer confidence, and strengthen long-term retention across the Intuit ecosystem. Powered by the world’s largest expert network and the Virtual Expert Platform (VEP)
, we are embedding AI + HI directly into the customer journey to create a durable competitive advantage.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an innovative, AI-native VP of Design
to provide executive leadership across ICS and VEP - the organization shaping how AI and human expertise work together to power a multi-billion-dollar services ecosystem and unlock an incremental $10B growth opportunity for Intuit.

You will lead an integrated design organization spanning platform product design and service design—along with research, design technology, operations, and design labs - aligning platform capability development, embedded service experiences, and go-to-market strategy into a unified system that drives adoption and growth.

This isn’t just a leadership role; it is an opportunity to architect the future of AI-powered, expert-driven financial services and redefine how millions of customers access trusted expertise by leading the platform design for the intersection of AI + HI.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

This is a high-impact executive role where you will own the end-to-end design strategy for our global expert and customer experiences.

Platform Product Design: Lead the design for the core capabilities used widely across the Intuit ecosystem by both customers and experts.

Drive service design across ICS to ensure AI and HI (Human Intelligence) experiences are cohesive, scalable, and effective across virtual and embedded models.
Vision & Strategy: Champion a bold, long-term vision for customer and experience experiences.
Design at Scale: Lead a massive design organization in building component libraries and design systems that power innovation across all Intuit offerings.

Experience Quality: Deliver measurable improvements in clarity and consistency across all ICS service journeys.

Qualifications

Customer-Obsession: You anchor strategy in customer needs and outcomes, balancing vision with measurable impact.

Strategic Storytelling: Masterful ability to visualize complex concepts and articulate a strategic vision that inspires developers, partners, and customers alike.
